name: The Crypt 2

features.description: The top three rows open via Forsaken Fingers.

features.name: xWays
features.description: Stretch reels with two or three symbols.

review:
The Crypt 2 is a 6-reel cascading sequel with seven rows, the top three locked until Forsaken Fingers open them. xNudge Wilds drop to the bottom of their reel, gaining a multiplier with each step, and become stacked wilds.

xWays mystery symbols hold two or three symbols and stretch the reels. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 31,248x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
